tips.text: Run the Granum Void solo; squad size raises the kill thresholds but not the spawns or the time.
Throw a 0-forma Xoris at specters and detonate it mid-air; it works on any frame, so do not sell it.
Stand on high ground and use Mesa's Peacemaker.
Clear the specter particles; they count toward the spawn cap and dry up spawns, which is how Mesa runs fall short.
Bring Octavia with Mallet and the second-mallet augment; specters kill themselves on it.
Revenant's Danse Macabre, Volt's Discharge, Protea's turret and Yareli's Surging Blades also clear it.
Bullet-jump onto a tall rock at the map edge and stay there; specters spawn in a radius around you and pile up at its base.
Bring a Railjack On Call crewmate or Syndicate Specters to do the killing; the gear wheel is not locked inside the Void.
Clear nearby enemies before using the Tribute and expect one Granum Void per mission; once it closes, every Tribute turns away.
Expect the Barrel to be the usual bad-luck part.
Most players treat this as a side effect of the Protea farm; runs take under a minute once you have a method.
